verifier: g2b (max2 round 2, adversarial card verifier after the g2 fix round: lisvel, nurrow, odrum, rishal, ulkro, vashil)
commitReviewed: 4ad68fa7f (g2 fix round c5c0c181f on top of verify_r2_g2a; Nurrow and Odrum card changes carried by wip sync f6f77879a)
method: Read every shipped splash and portrait (base and both skins, 6 fighters, 36 cards) in art/out/fighters/<id> at full size (splash 1600 x 900, portrait 512). Per fighter, sheets with each card at card size (480 px splash, 300 px portrait) next to the current subject pass (art/.cache/fighters/plates/<sid>_<kind>.png; the paint-cache _3d.png references are stale for Lisvel, Rishal, Ulkro skins and Vashil, older than the cards) and as chips at 128 and 64 px. Crops at 2-4x of every face, and of the hands of Nurrow (3 splashes), Odrum (base splash, Noon Fair splash and portrait), Ulkro (base, Highrim and Long Evening splashes, Long Evening portrait), Lisvel (base and Almanac splashes), Vashil (base splash), plus feet of Rishal, Nurrow Shadeprint and Vashil First Bell. Re-ran card_qa.py on the 6 fighters and node tools/gen_store.ts --check.
storeGate: pass: store.json current, 32 offers, 8 shelves, delta-E 32/32
cardQa: 36 cards, 0 gate misses (was 8 at g2a). High but under gate: nurrow portrait cracked 0.105, vashil_first_bell portrait cracked 0.080, ulkro_highrim splash hollow 11.1, rishal/rishal_chalkline/rishal_lamplit splash blank 0.62-0.63, vashil portrait blank 0.62, ulkro_long_evening splash blank 0.64. The tripwire passing does not clear the by-eye faces below.
scoreNote: Gauge only (a recent LoL splash: painted, dynamic, face-forward figure that owns the frame, strong value design). All 18 splashes are still the 3D finish (with local face or hand repaints) standing small and stiff on the plate, often in the plate's own hue (Nurrow orange on orange and lilac on lilac, Vashil Chalkline blue on blue, Lisvel Gorgewalk white on white). The fix round closed real defects (Nurrow's spiked hip hands, Odrum Noon Fair portrait's yoke hand, Lisvel Almanac's slack-string pose, the card_qa misses), but the face repaints are flat decal eyes that do not match the portraits, and several model-level hands are still broken. No fighter reaches 7.5.

perCard.issues: Teal wrap, smoky band with lidded eyes painted through it, small smile; at card size reads as a hooded archer with a visor. Watch: the lower face is a pale smooth cream oval (mannequin lean at 3x), the bow hand is a blocky stub, the figure is small and stiff in a static raise with the string slack.

Eyes read through the band at 512, 128 and 64; nose, lips and smile model; matches the current subject pass. Watch: the eyes sit on an opaque-looking silver band, so they can read as drawn on a blindfold.

perCard.shipped: 3d restaged (attack1 t 0.30) + face tone and eye retouch
perCard.issues: The head is an all-cream bandage wrap with a tan face inside it and a hard white band with black smudged eyes pasted across it: the strongest mummy read in the set at full and card size. The drawing hand at the cheek is a crumpled brown fragment (about x 945-1000, y 480-560), the bow-grip hand is a cracked pink block with glyph-like dark marks on the leather (about x 1130-1190, y 450-510), the figure is cut at mid-thigh and crowded into the lower-right corner, and the whole figure is tan on a tan plate.

Monochrome tan bandage-wrapped head with a tan face of nearly the same value: at 128 and 64 it reads as a mummy head with a visor. The bronze tone patch is blotchy at the right cheek and jaw (soft round blend visible at 512), and smoky dark shading rings both eyes.

perCard.shipped: 3d relit + face tone and eye retouch
perCard.issues: The new face tone is a flat orange oval pasted inside the white wrap with a hard edge on the near side (crop at 3x, about x 1050-1100, y 300-340); the eyes under the blue band sit in dark smoky sockets. The figure is still milky white on a pale plate at card size, small and stiff.

Warm face, smile and lidded eyes through the blue band read at 512, 128 and 64. Watch: dark smoke under the eyes, white wrap plus white scarf lean on the mummy read; its splash fails, so the skin would ship with mixed versions.

The hip hand is now a clean gloved fist with no needle ghosts at 3x; the blade hand and the sickle are intact; closed-lid smiling mask reads. Watch: a thin pale vertical seam runs from the brow past the left eye to the nose on the mask (not under the eye, so not a tear line, but keep it from growing); orange figure on an orange plate.
On-model, closed-lid smile. Watch: carved lines across the mask (cracked 0.105, highest in the set) read as carved wood at 512.

The spiked claw is gone: the hip hand is a gloved fist. Watch: the painted fist is a more saturated orange than the 3D glove and changes the gesture from an open hand on the hip to a fist; the bracer above it ends in a small jagged tip. Pink on peach separation weak.
On-model, closed lids, sickle hand acceptable at 3x.

The hip hand is now an open four-finger glove resting on the hip, no spidery claw at 3x; mask is the base's closed-lid smile. Watch: milky monochrome lilac on a lilac-pink plate (score, not a blocker); flat dark sole slab under the near foot.
On-model. Watch: crack lines on the forearm guard.

The photo-real eyes are replaced by flat decal eyes (grey lid over a black crescent, crisp outline, no pupil) on a pale over-lit full-face mask with crack nicks across the band, cheeks and chin and no mouth: at card size a glowing blank slab with two slits (hockey-mask / blank-mask class). It also no longer matches the base portrait, which has pupils and painted lids, so base splash and portrait show two different faces. The pot's blue round window still reads as a large eyeball beside the face. Off hand is fixed (closed fist).
Pupils and lids read at 512, 128 and 64; on-model. Watch: crack nicks on the band and cheek, a stern brow.

Unchanged by the fix round: the yoke hand is a fragmented mesh with visible pixel blocks at the top (about x 880-960, y 315-350) and the hip hand by the sash is a holed, folded mesh (about x 1230-1310, y 540-650). The paper-white mask carries crack marks and scorched brown rims around flat lid decals without pupils: blank white mask at card size.
The yoke hand now grips with readable fingers at 3x (the g2a fragment is gone); pupils and lids read. Watch: crack lines on the band.

The mask is a salmon-pink slab with dense crack lines and solid black almond eyes with no lid or pupil (crop at 3x, about x 1090-1240, y 120-260): solid-eye and cracked-face class, menacing at card size. It is not ruling 2's warm amber lacquer #B39272 with honey-amber inlays. Pale grey robe on a lilac plate reads cut-out.

Crack lines over the brow band, between the eyes and down both cheeks, plus a soft salmon smear across the left half of the mask (blotch at 2.5x); the eyes are flat grey-lid decals with an amber rim and no pupil. Cracked-face class at 512 and still visible at 128.

One lidded eye decal now shows on the visor, but the face plate below is pale and smooth with a thin frowning mouth and two long dark incised lines running down the cheek from under the visor (3x crop): tear-line / under-eye streak read (ruling 1) on a mannequin plate. Feet are grounded (contact shadows present). Figure small and stiff.
The eye is a tiny slit barely visible at 512 and gone at 128 and 64; pale face plate with incised cheek lines and the striated neck: blank mannequin read with streak lines.

White face plate with two vertical grey cheek lines and a frown under the lidded-eye visor (streak and mannequin read at 3x and a blank plate at card size); the chalk scribbles on the tabard and greaves read as scrawl at card size.

No eye resolves at 512; the dark visor drops in front of the face as a long beak with the pale incised plate below: blank, beaked helm read at 128 and 64. Glyph-like white marks on the wing plate read as letters.
Lidded eye decals on the visor, but the white face plate with dark incised cheek lines and a frown is a mannequin with streaks at 3x, and blank at card size.

The gold visor falls in front of the face as a long beak to the chin, with the pale plate beside it and only a tiny eye slit: beaked-mask (plague-doctor lean, cf. ruling on Dunsom) and blank at 128 and 64.

The see-through skirt is cropped out, but the off hand is still a fingerless orange paddle stump (about x 1270-1340, y 760-840) and the spear hand a mitten blob (about x 950-1050, y 770-850): lost or melted fingers in plain view. The eyes are flat decal crescents on the bandage wrap with no skin around them, unlike the base portrait's painted eyes and brows, so splash and portrait show two different faces; at chip size the full wrap with two black slits leans mummy.
Painted eyes and brows in the slit read at 512, 128 and 64; the right glove is a readable fist.

Not addressed by the fix round: the eyes are two hairline dark slits on a brown band (4x crop), invisible at card size, so the face reads as a blank wrap or mummy. Both spear hands are fragmented claws (about x 975-1005 and 1295-1335, y 480-520).
The eyes are two tiny white slits with a hairline centre on a brown band (3.5x crop): they read as white glints, not lidded eyes, and vanish at 64 px, where the face is a wrapped mummy head.

The right glove is now a clean painted fist, but the left glove on the thrower is still a fragmented orange mesh with lightning-shaped dark cracks (about x 960-1060, y 610-720). A dark sitting-cat silhouette stands in front of the lower robe (about x 1130-1200, y 810-900; also in the 3D render, not in ulkro.md's Long Evening spec), an unexplained prop at full size. Eyes are flat decals as on the base splash. The hood renders rose-pink, not ulkro.md's plum #5B3A5E (watch).
The raised glove at the lower right (about x 360-450, y 450-512) is still a holed, fragmented mesh with the background showing through the fingers at 512 (same in the 3D). Eyes are fine.

Teal pane with neat closed-lid lines, carved face plate (design, vashil.md section 3); the cowl now has a rounded arched top in the render. Watch: small stiff frontal stand, washed figure grade; the cowl's CW5 number is a geometry gate this card cannot close.
Closed-lid lines on the pane read at 512, 128 and 64; card_qa blank now 0.62 (under the gate). Rounded cowl.
Clean and on-model. Watch: at this yaw only one lid mark shows on the pane, a short dark slash that can read as a crack at 4x; blue figure on a blue plate.

The lid marks are two tiny dark ticks on a pale pane over a white grille plate: a blank faceless helm at 128 and 64 (card_qa blank 0.60, just under the gate). A soft grey-brown smudge sits on the cowl's lower right (about x 280-340, y 240-290), a stain-like patch at 512 (faintly present in the subject pass too).
Clean. Watch: no eye marks resolve at card size (one dark notch at 4x), the staff foot is still blown to white, and the neck under the face plate shows a wrinkled brown patch at 4x.

Changed since g2a: the pane's lid marks are now two dark jagged slashes, the left one with a crack-like tail (3x crop): at 512 they read as cracked glass or angry slits, not the base portrait's calm lid lines (card_qa cracked 0.080, second highest in the set).

problems.what: The eye decals fixed the visor, but the face plate below carries long dark incised cheek lines under the eye (tear-line class, ruling 1) on a pale smooth plate (mannequin); on Chalkline and Lamplit portraits the visor drops in front of the face as a beak and no eye resolves.
problems.fix: Units lane: remove or shorten the vertical cheek incisions on the face plate and give the plate a mouth and cheek shape that reads alive; on the portraits pick a yaw where the visor's beak does not cross the face and the eyes face camera. Re-render with build.py portraits rishal --only splash,portrait,icon --skins.

problems.what: The head repaints now paint flat decal eyes (grey lid over a black crescent, hard outline, no pupil, no skin around them) instead of the portraits' painted eyes with pupils, so base splash and portrait do not read as one character, and on Odrum's over-lit cracked mask the decals give a blank or hockey-mask read.
problems.fix: Paint the splash eyes from the same recipe as the shipped portraits (pupil, lid shadow, warm skin or lacquer around the eye), lower the mask's exposure so it stops glowing, and thin the crack nicks; check the splash and portrait faces side by side at 128 px before shipping.

problems.what: Salmon-pink cracked mask with solid black (splash) or pupil-less decal (portrait) eyes; ruling 2's warm amber lacquer with honey-amber inlays is not what ships.
problems.fix: Re-grade the Shadeprint mask to #B39272 in the card render, drop the crack texture on the mask, give the inlays a pupil and lid band; re-render both cards.

problems.what: Mummy read: the skins' cream/white bandage wraps around a face toned by a round soft retouch patch (blotchy on Almanac, a hard orange oval on Gorgewalk), with a pasted white eye band on Almanac. The Almanac restage also shows a crumpled drawing hand and a cracked bow-grip hand.
problems.fix: Give the skin wraps a value break from the face (darker or coloured band edge around the face opening, as the base's teal does), tone the face in the texture rather than with a screen-space patch, and check the drawing and grip hands at 3x; the base fighter's teal-wrap cards are the target.

problems.what: Broken hands in plain view: Odrum Noon Fair's yoke hand (pixel blocks) and hip hand (holed mesh); Ulkro's paddle-stump off hand and mitten spear hand on the base splash, both spear claws on Highrim, the cracked left glove on Long Evening splash and the holed raised glove on Long Evening portrait. The current 3D renders carry the same defects, so they come from the skin GLB hands.
problems.fix: Units lane: rebuild the Ulkro glove and Odrum Noon Fair hand meshes (closed fists are enough), or restage so the hands sit behind props; then re-render and re-run hand crops at 3x.

problems.what: Highrim was not part of the fix round: the eyes are hairline slits or white glints in a brown band, so the face reads as a blank wrap or mummy.
problems.fix: Apply the base portrait's painted-eye head pass to both Highrim cards and re-gate.

problems.what: A dark sitting-cat silhouette stands in front of the lower robe (also in the 3D render, not in the Long Evening spec), and the hood renders rose rather than plum.
problems.fix: Identify the mesh (likely a stray part or a pose-intersecting prop) and hide or remove it for the card; check the hood grade against #5B3A5E.

problems.what: First Bell's re-render turned the pane's lid marks into jagged crack-like slashes; Chalkline's lid ticks are too small to read and a smudge sits on the cowl.
problems.fix: Use the base portrait's lid-line decal on both skin panes (scaled for the pane), remove the Chalkline cowl smudge, re-render.

problems.what: Small, stiff figures in the plate's hue; no splash is a painted, figure-led composition.
problems.fix: Larger framing with a value break between figure and plate before another paint pass.

keepLive: the other 20 cards of the six fighters: lisvel_almanac x2, lisvel_gorgewalk_splash, rishal x6, odrum_splash, odrum_noon_fair_splash, odrum_shadeprint x2, ulkro_splash, ulkro_highrim x2, ulkro_long_evening x2, vashil_chalkline_portrait, vashil_first_bell_portrait
notes: 16 of 36 pass (g2a: 9); no fighter reaches par (7.5). Nurrow is the first fighter with all six cards passing. New passes: lisvel_splash, lisvel_portrait, lisvel_gorgewalk_portrait, the three Nurrow splashes, odrum_noon_fair_portrait, vashil_portrait. New fail: vashil_first_bell_portrait (passed at g2a; the 17:51 re-render changed the pane marks). Consistency caveat for the lead: odrum_portrait and ulkro_portrait pass but their base splashes fail with a different, decal-eyed face, so shipping only the portraits pairs them with pre-round-1 splashes; ship each with its splash or hold both. Same for lisvel_gorgewalk_portrait (its splash fails). The paint-cache _3d.png references for Lisvel, Rishal, Ulkro skins and Vashil are older than the shipped cards (Lisvel Almanac's _3d.png still shows the old cast_a3 pose), so any card_ab or paint gate against them compares with a stale render; the subject passes in art/.cache/fighters/plates are current. Read-only review: no card, tool or GLB was changed.
